capabilities.wealth_summary: GIB is mainly a wholesale and treasury bank (retail was 4% of H1 2026 revenue) and is now building wealth. Its June 2026 presentation lists Wealth Management and Digital Retail Banking (meem) among six core lines. Strategy aims include 'Scaling the private banking proposition by leveraging the Group's international footprint' and KSA retail 'focused on lucrative upper-mass and emerging-affluent segments' (S7). In April 2025 GIB signed a partnership with London-based Stanhope Capital Group to offer advisory, OCIO and discretionary wealth services to institutional and qualified private clients in the GCC, with alternatives and Sharia-compliant products (S9). In KSA, GIB Capital (CMA-licensed) runs asset management with AUM of SAR 16.5bn in 2025, up 61%. It also runs Saudi-market brokerage with margin lending and an e-trade app, and a brokerage and wealth management unit led by Hussain AlQahtani (S6, S14, S17, S19). GIB (UK) Ltd (GIB Asset Management) manages GCC equity and fixed-income strategies and indexation for international investors (S25). The meem app offers accounts, cards, financing and Murabaha deposits; no in-app investing was found (S23, S24).

private_banking.detail: Private banking is named as a business line, and strategy aims to scale it using GIB's international footprint ('Bespoke banking and lifestyle solutions with diversified global investment access') (S7 pp.7, 9). The client-facing service found is the Stanhope Capital partnership (advisory, OCIO, discretionary) for qualified private clients (S9). No private-banking product page, threshold or named head was found.

asset_management.detail: GIB Capital (Riyadh): public equity portfolios (passive, active, multi-factor), fixed income and money market (sukuk, bonds, structured products), local Shariah-compliant, GCC and MENA public funds, and alternatives (real estate, VC, PE, credit). AUM SAR 16.5bn in 2025 (+61%). The GIB Opportunistic MENA Equity Fund won two Lipper awards (S6 p.12, S18). GIB (UK) Ltd / GIB Asset Management (London, New York): GCC strategies and equity and fixed-income indexation for international investors, 100+ employees, AUM not disclosed (S25). The 2026 plan is to 'Broaden product mix' and 'Scale UK distribution for GIB Capital funds' (S7 p.10).

brokerage.detail: GIB Capital brokerage serves institutional and retail investors on the Saudi market (Tadawul), with margin lending against portfolio collateral and online trading via etrade.gibcapital.com. AR 2025 reports stronger brokerage performance on margin lending use and digital account-opening and fund-transaction improvements (S6 p.12, S19).

digital_investing.detail: Limited to GIB Capital's 'GIBC Tadawul' mobile app and e-trade portal for Saudi equities and funds (S20, S19). meem's KSA app offers OnePack, multi-currency accounts, cards, financing and Murabaha deposits; no in-app securities or fund investing was found (S23, S24).

advisory.detail: Stanhope partnership: advisory, outsourced CIO and discretionary wealth advisory for institutional and qualified private clients; platform covers equities, fixed income, hedge funds, PE and real estate, with Sharia-compliant expertise (S9). GIB Capital's CMA licence covers advising (S13).

discretionary.detail: GIB Capital's licensed activities include managing clients' portfolios, and it offers tailored equity portfolios (S13, S18). Stanhope partnership includes discretionary wealth advisory (S9).

model_portfolios_robo.detail: No robo-advice or model-portfolio product found on meem, GIB Capital or GIB sites (S18-S24).

funds_platform.detail: GIB Capital distributes its own public funds (S18). No third-party funds shelf on meem or GIB Capital was found. Stanhope's platform gives clients access to global managers (S9).

structured_products.detail: GIB Capital fixed-income strategies may invest in structured products (S18). Treasury offers hedging and structured treasury products to corporates (S6). No retail structured-note shelf found.

private_markets.detail: GIB Capital alternatives cover real estate, venture capital, private equity and credit (S18). Stanhope platform: 'access to top-quartile buyout and venture capital managers' as a core part of the offer (S9).

islamic_wealth.detail: GIB Capital offers local Shariah-compliant funds and sukuk strategies and has a Shariah Supervisory Committee (S18, S13). meem is a Shariah-compliant digital retail bank (Murabaha deposits) (S6, S24). Stanhope offering includes 'strong expertise in Sharia-compliant products' (S9).

Khaled Abbas appointed CEO GIB Saudi Arabia and Sara Abdulhadi CEO GIB B.S.C., taking both roles from the Group CEO
Strategic partnership with Stanhope Capital Group for GCC wealth advisory (advisory, OCIO, discretionary); asset and wealth management described as 'a key pillar of our growth'
GIB Capital AUM reached SAR 16.5bn (+61%); 'GiBi' internal AI large-language-model proof of concept; strategic investment in Tarabut
H.E. Abdulaziz Al-Arifi appointed Chairman, succeeding H.E. Fahad Alsaif

June 2026 investor presentation sets a five-year 'acceleration' strategy (Phase 1 H2 2026). It includes scaling private banking, KSA retail aimed at upper-mass and emerging-affluent customers, and retail partnerships 'via embedded-Finance, Non-bank Financial Institutions and Fintech'.
GIB B.S.C. established a US$3bn Certificate of Deposit Programme

opportunities: The June 2026 strategy targets 'Scaling the private banking proposition by leveraging the Group's international footprint', and 'Wealth Management' is listed as a core business line (S7 pp.4, 9).

KSA retail (meem) targets 'upper-mass and emerging-affluent segments' and plans 'Partnerships via embedded-Finance, Non-bank Financial Institutions and Fintech' (S7 pp.9-10). The meem app shows no in-app investing; it offers accounts, cards, financing and Murabaha deposits only (S23, S24).
The meem Elite tier (SAR 200k+ average balance, dedicated RM) exists, but no investment product is attached to it (S21).
Asset management aims to 'Broaden product mix' and 'Scale UK distribution for GIB Capital funds' (S7 p.10). GIB Capital AUM grew 61% to SAR 16.5bn in 2025 (S6).
barriers: Wealth advisory, OCIO and discretionary services for qualified private and institutional clients are already partnered with Stanhope Capital (since Apr 2025) (S9).
In-house asset management and brokerage sit at GIB Capital (KSA) and GIB (UK) Ltd (S18, S19, S25).

Retail is small: 4% of H1 2026 revenue (S7 p.17). H1 2026 net income fell 45% because of provisions and Gulf geopolitical disruption, and Phase 1 of the strategy is described as a 'disrupted start' (S7 pp.12, 14).
meem is Shariah-compliant, so investment products would need Shariah screening (S24).
